title: Avatar marketplace
subtitle: A new face for your next interview. Browse avatars created by the community.
emptyDescription: New avatars will appear here after review. Come back soon, or create a listing of your own.
previewHint: Only an image preview is shown here. The avatar is added to your collection after purchase.
noDescription: The creator has not added a description.
coinsOnly: Pay with coins. Coin purchases are final and cannot be refunded or exchanged for cash.
checkoutTitle: Add this avatar to your collection?
checkoutDescription: You are buying one avatar for your personal inventory. Your existing slot capacity does not change.
unknownPurchase: We could not confirm the outcome. The purchase may have completed. Retry here to recover the same purchase without paying twice.
priceChanged: The price changed. Reload the listing and confirm its new price before purchasing.
deletedReplay: The original purchase was processed, but its avatar is no longer in your collection. This receipt does not restore it.
slotsRequired: Your inventory is full. Free a slot or buy more capacity before purchasing.
insufficient: You need more coins for this purchase.
leaveUnknown: Closing does not cancel a purchase that may have completed. You can check your collection and transaction history.
listingsSubtitle: Create a listing, follow its review, and manage what is available for sale.
myEmptyDescription: Sell an eligible avatar you created. Purchased avatars cannot be resold.
formHint: Save a draft first. Submit it when the information and rights declaration are ready for review.
noEligibleDescription: Only ready avatars you created can be listed. Each asset can have one listing; purchased copies cannot be resold.
titlePlaceholder: Give your avatar a recognizable name
descriptionPlaceholder: What makes this avatar a good fit for an interview?
personalityHint: Describe how this avatar should conduct an interview. Buyers receive this default personality.
rightsHint: Explain your right to sell this avatar, including ownership, licenses, and any restrictions.
submitHint: Your listing will be locked while an administrator reviews it. It becomes public only after approval.
delistHint: Delisting is final. Existing buyers keep their avatars. This listing cannot be relisted.
rejectedHint: Edit and save your listing before submitting it again.
terminalHint: This listing is closed for new purchases. Existing buyers keep their avatars. It cannot be relisted.
pendingHint: An administrator is reviewing your listing. Editing is locked until a decision is made.
activeHint: Your listing is live. To stop future purchases, delist it. Live listings cannot be edited.
staleDescription: Another action updated the listing. Your changes have not been saved. Reload its latest details and review them before trying again.
dirtyDescription: Your changes have not been saved. Stay to keep editing or leave to discard them.
reviewSubtitle: Review the seller’s exact listing and rights declaration before publishing it.
queueEmptyDescription: Listings matching this status will appear here.
assetNotReady: Asset is not ready. Approval is unavailable.
approveHint: Approving makes this exact version available to buyers. Check the rights declaration and personality before continuing.
rejectHint: Explain what the seller needs to change. They can edit the rejected listing and resubmit.
suspendHint: This permanently stops new purchases. Existing buyers keep their avatars. Suspension cannot be undone.
reasonRequired: Enter a reason between 1 and 2,000 characters.
titleLength: Enter a title between 1 and 100 characters.
textLength: Use between 1 and 2,000 characters (description may be empty).
priceInvalid: Enter a whole number of coins between 1 and 1,000,000.
